name: Empordà

communes: Cruïlles, Monells I Sant Sadurní De L'Heura

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Catalan DO in the northeastern corner of Catalonia, in Girona province. Its vineyards lie in two separate zones: Alt Empordà, from around Figueres north to the French border, and Baix Empordà near the Mediterranean. Garnacha, Macabeo, Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah are among its allowed grapes.
